comment: A very easy class. Just do the work on a very minimal basis and you will get an A.

She is the BEST professor I have ever had in my entire academic career. If you are interested in finance, definitely take her class. Throughout the semester, you develop valuable financial skills, she is dope. Such a caring person and amazing personality!
Her Fin 270 class is a must if you are concentrating in finance. Its class you can actually enjoy going to.

She is amazing and by far one the best professors at UR. You actually learn in her classes, you arent just regurgitating useless formulas. She is a great asset and really cares about her field and it is clear she wants to be helpful.

Dr. Alexander's a very fair grader and provides lots of content in the way of HW and review to keep up with, but if you stay on top of it you'll learn a lot and easily get an A. Dr. Alexander wants to see her students succeed and she's a great resource to have if you're looking to break into finance after school. Definitely the best FIN360 teacher.

She was a great teacher and I wish I had taken her a semester earlier, but she only had one review when I initially thought of taking the class. You have to work for your grade but she is really nice and made me sure I wanted to do Finance as my concentration. Probably my favorite teacher in the B-school. Only regret was not taking her sooner.

Dr. Alexander is the best professor that I have had at the business school in my 3 years here. She stimulates students' interests and makes them want to continue on into Finance. After declaring my Finance concentration, I became unsure if that is what I wanted to do, and Dr. Alexander helped me reaffirm that. She is an incredible professor.
Professor Alexander is the BY FAR the greatest teacher I have had at the University of Richmond.

Professor Alexander is one of my favorite Professors at UR. She is always willing to help you and provides great information in her course packet. Her grading is fair and she gives you plenty of heads-up for deadlines.
Great professor and super nice. Gives you plenty of practice problems and does not test on anything that has not been covered. Work hard and you will do well in her class.
Super nice, doesn't grade you on anything unexpected. Just be sure to read the textbook.
